item.title: PG&E blackout: slow responses, AI, and paper blueprints to blame, officials say
item.description: A massive PG&E power outage and the ensuing fallout was exacerbated by poor communication, a poorly-trained AI model, and issues putting out a substation set ablaze.

item.title: How Patrick Bailey and Buster Posey are preparing for MLB’s new challenge system
item.description: The Giants’ president of baseball operations is embracing ABS, and his Gold Glove starting catcher is looking to find an edge by the start of the season.

item.title: One man’s trail of alleged abuse through SF’s private club scene
item.description: As allegations mounted against Michael “Mickey” Gerold, some clubs and bars banned him. But others drew him even closer.

item.title: 19 ways to celebrate Lunar New Year in San Francisco
item.description: Celebrate the Year of the Horse with tai chi, mahjong, lion dancing, night markets, and more.

item.title: The best date-night restaurants in SF, according to a panel of restaurant pros
item.description: Whether your ideal evening includes dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant or karaoke at a classic dive, we’ve got a recommendation for your next night out.

item.title: STRIKE OVER: SFUSD and teachers union reach tentative contract agreement
item.description: The deal gives teachers 4% raises over two years and fully funded healthcare for dependents, ending a four-day work stoppage that roiled the city.

item.title: How Bay FC pulled off a $1.1 million transfer for a rising U.S. star
item.description: The club acquired midfielder Claire Hutton, 20, from the Kansas City Current in the most expensive transfer since the franchise was founded.

item.title: Defining second-half success for the Warriors
item.description: Here are five ways Golden State can score little victories after the All-Star break.

item.title: The SFUSD teachers strike is over. Now come the ‘difficult choices’
item.description: At a Friday press conference, Superintendent Su said layoffs and school closures are still on the table.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: As Celebrini takes Olympics star turn, what’s next for Sharks?
item.description: As Macklin Celebrini gains valuable experience with Team Canada, San Jose is hoping to surround its 19-year-old star with more talent.
